samuel1.12.p1.b1.text: Then Samuel said to all Israel

samuel1.12.p1.b2.text: Now here is the king walking before you, and I am old and gray … I have walked before you from my youth until this day.

samuel1.12.p1.b3.text: Whose ox or donkey have I taken? … Tell me, and I will restore it to you.

samuel1.12.p1.b4.text: You have not wronged us or oppressed us … nor have you taken anything from the hand of man.

samuel1.12.p2.b1.text: The LORD is the One who appointed Moses and Aaron, and who brought your fathers up out of the land of Egypt.

samuel1.12.p2.b2.text: Now present yourselves, so that I may confront you before the LORD …

samuel1.12.p2.b3.text: When Jacob went to Egypt, your fathers cried out to the LORD

samuel1.12.p2.b4.text: and He sent them Moses and Aaron, who brought your fathers out of Egypt and settled them in this place.

samuel1.12.p3.b1.text: But they forgot the LORD their God

samuel1.12.p3.b2.text: and He sold them into the hand of Sisera the commander of the army of Hazor, and into the hands of the Philistines and the king of Moab, who fought against them.

samuel1.12.p3.b3.text: We have sinned, for we have forsaken the LORD and served the Baals and Ashtoreths. Now deliver us from the hands of our enemies, that we may serve You.

samuel1.12.p3.b4.text: So the LORD sent Jerubbaal, Barak, Jephthah, and Samuel, and He delivered you from the hands of your enemies on every side, and you dwelt securely.

samuel1.12.p4.b1.text: But when you saw that Nahash king of the Ammonites was moving against you, you said to me, ‘No, we must have a king to rule over us’—even though the LORD your God was your king.

samuel1.12.p4.b2.text: Now here is the king you have chosen, the one you requested. Behold, the LORD has placed a king over you.

samuel1.12.p4.b3.text: If you fear the LORD and serve Him and obey His voice … and if both you and the king who reigns over you follow the LORD your God, then all will be well.

samuel1.12.p4.b4.text: But if you disobey the LORD and rebel against His command, then the hand of the LORD will be against you as it was against your fathers.

samuel1.12.p5.b1.text: Now, therefore, stand and see this great thing that the LORD will do before your eyes.

samuel1.12.p5.b2.text: Is it not the wheat harvest today? I will call on the LORD to send thunder and rain …

samuel1.12.p5.b3.text: So Samuel called to the LORD, and on that day the LORD sent thunder and rain. As a result, all the people greatly feared the LORD and Samuel.

samuel1.12.p6.b1.text: Pray to the LORD your God for your servants so that we will not die! For we have added to all our sins the evil of asking for a king.

samuel1.12.p6.b2.text: Do not be afraid … Even though you have committed all this evil, do not turn aside from following the LORD, but serve the LORD with all your heart.

samuel1.12.p6.b3.text: Do not turn aside after worthless things that cannot profit you or deliver you, for they are empty … for the sake of His great name, the LORD will not abandon His people

samuel1.12.p7.b1.text: As for me, far be it from me that I should sin against the LORD by ceasing to pray for you. And I will continue to teach you the good and right way.

samuel1.12.p7.b2.text: Above all, fear the LORD and serve Him faithfully with all your heart; consider what great things He has done for you.

samuel1.12.p7.b3.text: But if you persist in doing evil, both you and your king will be swept away.”
